mean_squared_error.name: mean_squared_error
mean_squared_error.doc:
Computes mean squared error

Args:
    preds: estimated labels
    target: ground truth labels

Return:
    Tensor with MSE

Example:

    >>> x = torch.tensor([0., 1, 2, 3])
    >>> y = torch.tensor([0., 1, 2, 2])
    >>> mean_squared_error(x, y)
    tensor(0.2500)
mean_squared_error.source_code:
def mean_squared_error(preds: torch.Tensor, target: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """
    Computes mean squared error

    Args:
        pred: estimated labels
        target: ground truth labels

    Return:
        Tensor with MSE

    Example:

        >>> x = torch.tensor([0., 1, 2, 3])
        >>> y = torch.tensor([0., 1, 2, 2])
        >>> mean_squared_error(x, y)
        tensor(0.2500)

    """
    sum_squared_error, n_obs = _mean_squared_error_update(preds, target)
    return _mean_squared_error_compute(sum_squared_error, n_obs)
